not_applicable.reason: The parts of this rule about showing a secret do not apply, because sdr-grader never reads or holds a secret. The part about the arguments of a child process applies, and the case mask-009 tests it.
sdr-grader never reads or shows a client ID.
sdr-grader reads no credential file, writes no credential file and creates no credentials folder.
sdr-grader reads no credential fields. sdr-grader does not look up a credential. In the --dataview and --rsid modes the generator child, cja_auto_sdr or aa_auto_sdr, looks it up.
sdr-grader reads no credential variables. The generator child inherits the environment unchanged and reads them.
sdr-grader builds no profile path. It checks the --profile name and passes it to the generator child, which owns the profile folders.
sdr-grader has no config check, because it has no credential lookup to report. Use the config check of the generator.
sdr-grader does not call Adobe, so it has no live test. Use the live test of the generator. When the child fails, sdr-grader names the generator's --profile-test command.
sdr-grader does not call Adobe, so it cannot detect a credential with no product access. The generator reports it.
sdr-grader does not look up a credential. In the --dataview and --rsid modes the generator child, cja_auto_sdr or aa_auto_sdr, looks it up.
sdr-grader does not look up a credential. In the --dataview and --rsid modes the generator child, cja_auto_sdr or aa_auto_sdr, looks it up.
sdr-grader has no scopes. sdr-grader does not look up a credential. In the --dataview and --rsid modes the generator child, cja_auto_sdr or aa_auto_sdr, looks it up.
